newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul gold trade quieter as prices firm.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul gold trade quieter as prices firm.

text.p: Istanbul's gold exchange saw quieter trade on Thursday as firmer prices reduced volume to 1,405 kilos from Wednesday's 1,717 kilos, dealers said.
Gold rose to $334.00 an ounce and 1,599,000 lira per gram, compared to $332.60 and 1,595,500 lira on Wednesday, following a bounce back from lows in European markets.
"There was a small amount of arbitrage by the banks today, but most of the trade was due to physical demand from the free market," one dealer said.
The Turkish currency eased to 149,400 against the dollar, from Wednesday's close of 149,010 lira.
Almost all the day's trade -- 1,295 kilos -- took place in the morning session with 57.1 percent of the total volume conducted in lira terms.
